definition: For a frame F and standpoint w let S={a | F.access w a}. maskedStep F w a b means a∈S and F.access a b. SuccessorConnected F w means for every ordered a,b∈S, Mathlib Relation.ReflTransGen (maskedStep F w) a b. Zero-length paths are included. A masked edge may exit S but cannot continue from outside S; restrict_path proves that paths ending in S can be restricted to edges with both endpoints in S. Thus this is directed connectivity of every ordered successor pair within the induced successor subgraph. Empty and singleton S satisfy it without existence assumptions.
note: Exact mathematical frame correspondence for #437, not a claim about metaphysical worlds, source intent, or which propositions count as metaphysically possible. Uses Mathlib relation closure and existing GraphBridge imports rather than a new graph implementation.
